system.name: TWA (Training with Annotations)
system.one_liner: A finetuning algorithm that uses span-level error annotations: error spans get a weighted unlikelihood loss, off-trajectory tokens are ignored, the rest get cross entropy.

content.variant_note: one annotated translation redrawn as tokens, weights and loss glyphs in shared columns, ending in the span-loss formula
content.argues: Span-level annotations turn into per-token weights that decide, token by token, whether cross entropy, unlikelihood or no loss applies.
content.subject: One annotated translation with two error spans, followed from text to tokens, weights, loss type and the span-loss formula.

lessons.what_to_learn: Align a token row, a weight row and a row of loss glyphs in shared columns so one annotated sentence shows how each annotation becomes a per-token training signal; box the columns where one span-level loss applies and tie the box to the formula with a leader arrow.

non-error tokens following an error span are ignored as they are off-trajectory

summary: Training with Annotations (TWA) finetunes a machine translation model on outputs that carry span-level error annotations. Figure 1 follows a single example: a correct sentence and a submitted translation with an orange minor-error span ('a story about') and a red major-error span ('disguise'). A curved arrow tokenizes it, a row of weights (1, 1, -1, -1, -1, 0, 0, 0, -5, -5, 0) sits under the tokens, and a row of glyphs says which loss each token gets: green up arrows for cross entropy, red down arrows in boxes for the weighted unlikelihood on each error span, grey crosses for ignored off-trajectory tokens. The span-loss formula and a bracket caption close the figure; two small keys explain the colours and the glyphs.
summary_zh: TWA 用带跨度级错误标注的翻译输出来微调机器翻译模型。图一以一个例句为线索：标出轻微与严重错误，分词后给每个词元赋权重，再用绿色上箭头、红色下箭头和灰色叉号表示交叉熵、似然惩罚与不计损失，最后给出跨度损失公式。
